researchProtocol: Rolling origin: train only on seasons before each evaluation season; 2006-2026 evaluated after a three-season initialization window.

game.protocol: For each season 2008-2026, fit logistic calibration only on earlier rolling-origin predictions.

series.protocol: For each season 2008-2026, fit logistic calibration only on earlier rolling-origin predictions.

gamePropagatedThroughExactSeries.protocol: For each eligible season, fit the game calibrator only on earlier rolling-origin game predictions, calibrate each possible future game's home-win probability, then recompute the pre-series probability with the exact series solver.

game.protocol: For each season, predict the prior-season empirical home-team win rate using only earlier seasons.

series.protocol: For each season, predict the prior-season empirical team-A series win rate using only earlier seasons.

sensitivityReliability.interpretation: Grouped reliability diagnostic only. A binary outcome cannot validate an individual probability interval, and these sensitivity bands are not prediction-interval coverage guarantees.

availability.protocol: Only sourced observations timestamped strictly before a series begins are eligible. No status is inferred from game outcomes or retrospective participation.
limitations: Game participation is not used as a proxy because it is only known after the forecast deadline.
The absence of a sourced report is not evidence that a player was healthy.
Until coverage is material, injury and replacement-minute effects remain unvalidated historically.

inputAudit.conservativeDeadline: Inputs must be timestamped before 00:00 UTC on seriesStartDate because historical tip times are not retained.

laggedRotations.rule: Do not infer a pre-series rotation from games played after the deadline. Only named, sourced, lagged observations totaling 240 minutes are eligible.

externalBenchmarks.rule: Only timestamped public probabilities or explicitly no-vig two-sided series prices are eligible. Closing prices observed after the deadline are excluded.

registration.formula: logit(P(team A wins series)) = intercept + beta1 × exact SRS-series logit + beta2 × seed difference

registration.rule: Fit the unchanged SRS + home expected-margin model using at most the ten completed seasons immediately before each target season.

modelSelectionGate.uncertaintyMethod: Paired season-clustered bootstrap with 10,000 deterministic resamples.
modelSelectionGate.multiplicityPolicy: Exactly one primary challenger is promotion-eligible; all other candidates are exploratory and cannot be promoted from the same evaluation.

registrationClassification.provenance: First durable main-branch registration was 2026-07-27, after the 2026 playoffs began on 2026-04-18.

registration.rule: After prediction, split 12% of margin residual between opponents; carry adjustment through that postseason and cap at ±4 points.

registration.formula: shrunkPlayerDiff = playerDiff × exp(-abs(srsDiff) / 5); fit with SRS difference and home court.
registration.primaryMetric: season-clustered rolling-origin game Brier versus srs_home
registration.secondaryMetric: season-clustered rolling-origin series Brier versus srs_home
registration.promotionRule: Research-only on all history through 2025; promotion requires a lower primary metric on a genuinely future archived season without changing the formula.
